product_metadata.title: Anolon Advanced Hard Anodized Nonstick Frying Pan / Fry Pan / Hard Anodized Skillet with Helper Handle - 14 Inch, Brown,84121,Bronze
features: DURABLE FRYING PAN CONSTRUCTION: Heavy-duty, hard-anodized construction provides quick and even heat distribution to help reduce hot spots that can burn foods
PREMIUM NONSTICK COOKWARE: Frying pan features premium-quality PFOA-free bronze nonstick for superior food release and effortless cleanup
STURDY, DUAL-RIVETED HANDLES: Anolon SureGrip handles are designed for a comfortable grasp and dual riveted for extra strength
HELPER HANDLE: Large skillet features a convenient helper handle, handy when transferring recipes from one kitchen station to another
OVEN SAFE: Large nonstick frying pan is conveniently oven safe to 400 degrees F
description: Prepare professional-quality entrees, one-dish meals and more with the spacious Angolan advanced Bronze hard-anodized Nonstick 14-inch skillet with helper handle. Because Angolan cookware is designed for creativity in the kitchen's), this skillet features heavy-duty, hard-anodized construction providing even heating for exceptional cooking performance. The premium-quality, bronze-toned nonstick surface inside and out is ideal for easy cleanup, PFOA-free, and metal utensil safe, and delivers superior durability. The skillet's wide diameter makes it easier to toss foods and turn steel-cut oatmeal pancakes or veggie burgers. This skillet's handle and convenient helper handle feature revolutionary Angolan sure grip. Both rubberized stainless steel handles provide a confident, soft grasp when moving the skillet around the kitchen and are dual riveted for extra strength and oven safe to 400 Degree, allowing home chefs to sear a Pork tenderloin on the stovetop and finish it in the oven. Along With the rest of the Angolan advanced cookware line, This skillet works well with the other items in all the Angolan advanced collections. With the extra-large Angolan advanced Bronze hard-anodized Nonstick 14-inch skillet with helper handle, cooks can prepare full-family skillet meals and more any day of the week.
